campSiteCrossCheck.purpose: Test whether category-57 records provide evidence of missing category-55 milestone destinations; they do not by category alone.
campSiteCrossCheck.mergeRule: MarkerDuplicatesRemover resolves category55 plus category57 to category57 when merging identical positions of the same DID within a landblock.
campSiteCrossCheck.limitation: No raw pre-merge provenance or live bindability was validated. Do not add camp-sites to the runtime milestone catalogue solely because object type or merged categories overlap.
